content:
Jules (Growth): Quick plan: trying an "evening nudge" for the benchmark newsletter to capture APAC evening readers + NAM late shoppers. Need a compact 3-email registrant drip and a 2-email rescue for click-but-no-reg. Also want a send-window test: morning vs evening for segmented cohorts.
Ava (Lifecycle): Segments: 1) Engaged (clicked CTA / pricing in 30d), 2) RepeatVisitor (>2 pageviews), 3) RegisterOnly. VIP enterprise slice gets concierge CTA and alternate cadence. Rescue flow: immediate finish-signup nudge, 48h highlight.
Tom (Content): Drafting confirm + 48h highlight + day-of. For evening nudge variant, keep subject shorter and include "on-demand if you miss it". I'll write 4 subject lines to A/B: A) "Benchmark drop: 2 charts you need" B) "See what teams built last quarter" C) "Evening: quick benchmark highlights" D short "Benchmark highlights".
Rhea (Design): Building two templates: "evening-lite" (compact, dark header) and "standard" (desktop hero). Adding a small block for Dedicated customers that swaps in a case study CTA. Will provide mobile-first HTML + AMP-lite RSVP button.
Ibrahim (Analytics): UTMs: utm_campaign=evening_nudge_benchmark_v1&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Metrics: RSVP rate, click->rsvp, attend, 7d trial-start. Targets: Engaged RSVP 15-18%, RepeatVisitor 7-9%, RegisterOnly 2-3%. Audience est ~46k (~5.5k engaged). I'll set up A/B test for send window using RSVP as primary lift metric.
Jules (Growth): Automation notes: tag `webinar_status=registered` -> enroll evening_nudge_v1. Score: click +2, rsvp +6, attend +18. Rescue webhook: POST /hooks/finish-signup with payload `{"lead_id": "{{lead_id}}", "source": "email_click"}`. Dedicated clicks -> /ae/handoff.
Ava (Lifecycle): QA seedlist: 50 internal addr across growth, sales, cs, eng. Please include mobile testers in APAC.
Tom (Content): Add preview text tests too. Evening subject should lead with urgency + recording note. Also prepare a short CEO quote for high-intent emails to increase credibility.
Rhea (Design): I'll attach both templates and a 600x200 chart image. Also create a tiny "share with a colleague" CTA that triggers referral tag.
Ibrahim (Analytics): I'll provision a live dashboard and schedule a post-send cohort export. Also recommend sending the evening cohort at 7pm local vs morning at 10am local for test. We'll randomize by account to avoid timezone leakage.
Jules (Growth): Owners: Jules (campaign lead), Ava (automation & routing), Tom (copy + subjects), Rhea (creative), Ibrahim (metrics). Can we get final assets + test sends by Thursday EOD?
ops-bot: Ticket created MK-6082 for campaign config, routing, and seedlist. Link: https://app.redwood/boards/MK-6082 :white_check_mark:
Ava (Lifecycle): :thumbsup: I'll start wiring the webhooks and routing once templates land.
Ibrahim (Analytics): Will run a quick sanity check on seed opens/clicks and report back.
Tom (Content): I'll post subject/body drafts in the doc and ping for final copy approval tomorrow.
Jules (Growth): If we hit RSVP targets, plan a follow-up trial nudge 48h after attend. Also include a 1-week AE flag for high-value no-shows.
